232-678-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
232-678-8227.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

883-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5670-5933.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-5933.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Popular Egotist and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5570-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
5570-6972-8095.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

215-3443-7730.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-7730.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-7730.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

924-1115-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-1115-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-1115-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-1115-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

2292-4802--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

147-5256-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5256-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5256-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

1020-2866-2906-5231.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1020-2866-2906-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Repeat.

679-2894-3595-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-2894-3595-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Shambling Shell. Then, the draw will be replaced by Shambling Shell's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Shambling Shell from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-3430-3480-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-3480-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4306-4324.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
1978-4306-4324.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Workshop Elders.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

304-1978-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Tough Cookie.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2173-2438-5220-6578.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
2173-2438-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

2527-3143-3464-6798.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-3143-3464-6798.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

443-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
443-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2511-3951-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2511-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

654-5412-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-5412-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

877-1374-5910-6580.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to The Darkness Crystal and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

695-813-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Settle Beyond Reality.
695-813-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1274-2034-3490-4476.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-4476.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

225-2557-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
225-2557-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sicknes.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-2557-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 4 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

215-3821-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{U}.
215-3821-5778.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-3490-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
2049-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2440-3263-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cat.
2440-3263-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {2}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Cat you control.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control at least two Cats outside of Whitemane Lion, this combo nets infinite mana.

2034-3169-3603-4404-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Cloudshift without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

280-1479-3703.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-3703.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
